THE ENTIRE BACKGROUND MUST BE SOLID PURE MAGENTA, RGB(255,0,255), edge to edge, filling every pixel that is not the subject — a flat chroma-key backdrop, NOT white, NOT grey, NOT a coloured wash, NOT a gradient, NOT a vignette, NOT a scene, NOT a sky, NOT a border or frame. No ground, no cast shadow, no horizon, no text, no watermark, no second copy. All four corners of the image must be that same flat magenta.

NO PEOPLE AND NO FIGURE OF ANY KIND. This object is drawn ALONE — no person, no hands, no arms, no shoulders, no silhouette, no face. It will be layered BEHIND a character in the app, so anything person-shaped in this image would appear as a second body.

A GRAPEVINE GROWING UP BOTH SIDES OF AN EMPTY CENTRE. Two woody vines rise from the bottom corners of the frame, climb and curl inward toward the top, and meet in a loose arch across the upper edge. THE MIDDLE OF THE IMAGE MUST BE EMPTY MAGENTA, a tall clear column from top to bottom about one third the width of the image — a person will stand in that gap, so nothing may cross it. Broad green vine leaves, curling tendrils, and several heavy clusters of dark purple grapes hanging from the sides. Gnarled brown woody stems, fresh green new growth. Nothing at the bottom centre: the vines' roots are at the far left and far right.

Warm hand-illustrated storybook style, clean shapes and soft painted shading, no line art, no photorealism, no cel-shading outlines. Portrait orientation, the whole object inside the frame with a little magenta visible all the way around it. Colours and values separated clearly enough that the shape still reads when the whole object is only 60 pixels tall against a dark background.
